leaderCorrection: An enterprise has an office with duties and skills; the Academy provides a cohort-formed character to fill that office as its officer. Humanized and agentic continuity is persistent character law; ephemeral data/model calls are animations under the hood.

constitutiveRelation.office: receiver-owned continuing seat of duties, skills, authority, and answerability
constitutiveRelation.character: Academy-formed persistent operating component and union of its dispositions, disciplines, skills, masks, and chronicles
constitutiveRelation.appointment: receiver-owned double settlement of recognition and induction
constitutiveRelation.officer: the incumbency relation joining one character to one office
constitutiveRelation.animation: one ephemeral model/provider/harness/context/tool call acting as the character under an exact grant; neither character nor officer

person: self and personnel identity; enrollment never transfers ownership

learning: A character is improved by witnessed plays admitted into its chronicle and their closure into disciplines, skills, duties, and successor professional epochs—not by asserting that a prompt, policy stack, or model weight is the character.
temporality: Cohort lineage versions formation and character standing independently of receiver office succession and independently of ephemeral provider iteration.
